comparison_caveat: The clean forecast signals use matched three-comparison mode-selection paths: generic26_fused to generic16_fused for width, and generic16_nonfused to generic16_fused for fusion. The raw generic non-fused width and width-26 fusion deltas each contain an observed 20-CU mode-selection asymmetry. Production26 already uses the current fused three-product helper, so its delta to generic16_fused is not an old-v4-to-v5 comparison.

conclusion: The clean matched-selection-depth signals are 37613 CU for fused width 26-to-16 and 21316 CU for width-16 three-product fusion. The raw non-fused width delta of 37593 CU and raw width-26 fusion delta of 21296 CU each contain the observed 20-CU mode-selection asymmetry. Production26 already invokes the current fused three-product helper; its 39323-CU marked-kernel delta to generic16-fused is not an old-v4-to-v5 comparison. Its parse/preparation-interval delta was 3603 CU, the two marked intervals differed by 42926 CU, and the separately recorded transaction-total delta was 42926 CU. Marked absolute values include the disclosed marker/log overhead, and the first interval includes output allocation. No tag65 headroom or full-v5 fit claim is derived from this isolated probe.
